CheckpointManifestV1.description: The manifest.json written beside model.safetensors in every saved checkpoint. Two parties write it: the attached trainer supplies the fields it owns (BRD-02 R-02.20), and miLLM adds the rest at save time (BRD-01 R-01.12). This file is the normative field list for both; neither BRD restates it.

base_model.description: Written by miLLM. The root model this lineage descends from.
base_model.title: Base Model

created_at.description: Written by miLLM. RFC 3339 timestamp of the save.
created_at.title: Created At

domain.description: Written by the trainer. What this run is biasing the model toward.
domain.title: Domain

grader_hash.description: Written by the trainer. Hash of the grader configuration (BRD-02 R-02.10). Null when the run used no grader.
grader_hash.title: Grader Hash

name.description: Written by miLLM. The fully qualified name, '<base_model>:<run_id>:step-<step>', with step UNPADDED. This is the display and API form: what /v1/models lists (BRD-01 R-01.15) and what a completion reports as its resolved model.
name.title: Name

optimizer.description: Written by the trainer. Which optimizer produced this step, and whether its state was carried in or started fresh.

parent.description: Written by the trainer. The 'name' of the checkpoint this one descends from, or null for a checkpoint saved directly off the base model. This is the edge BRD-01 R-01.16 walks to build lineage.
parent.title: Parent

retention.description: Written by the trainer. The out-of-domain score at this step (BRD-02 R-02.17), carrying the floor the run stops at.
retention.title: Retention

run_id.description: Written by the trainer. Stable for the life of a run; a new run_id is a new branch (BRD-02 R-02.23).
run_id.title: Run Id

selector_hash.description: Written by the trainer. Hash of the selector configuration (BRD-02 R-02.10). Null when the run used no selector.
selector_hash.title: Selector Hash

signal_source.description: Written by the trainer. Which signal source produced the batches for this run (BRD-02 section 5.2).
signal_source.title: Signal Source

step.description: Written by the trainer. THE CANONICAL STEP NUMBER, as an integer. Every rendered form derives from this one value: the checkpoint directory is 'step-' plus this zero-padded to six digits (step-000500), and 'name' is 'step-' plus this unpadded (step-500). Padding in the path exists so directories sort lexicographically; it is a path convention, not part of the step's identity. Nothing may carry the step as a string of its own.
step.title: Step

test.description: Written by the trainer. The in-domain score at this step (BRD-02 R-02.16, R-02.18). Null when no test ran at this step.
test.title: Test

weights_sha256.description: Written by miLLM. Hash of model.safetensors, verified on load (BRD-01 R-01.14). Only ever written from a clean parameter set (BRD-01 R-01.11).
weights_sha256.title: Weights Sha256

CheckpointManifestV1.title: CheckpointManifestV1

OptimizerIdentity.description: Which optimizer produced a step, and the provenance of its state.

config_hash.description: Hash of the optimizer hyperparameters (learning rate, warmup, betas, batch size, accumulation).
config_hash.title: Config Hash

state.description: 'restored' when optimizer state was loaded from trainer-state for the resumed step, 'fresh' when a new optimizer was started on loaded weights. BRD-02 R-02.22 requires this be recorded, because a fresh optimizer on a mid-run checkpoint produces a loss discontinuity that is otherwise unexplained.
state.title: State

OptimizerIdentity.title: OptimizerIdentity

ScoreRecord.description: A score against a named evaluation set at one step.

floor.description: The value the run stops below. Set for retention (BRD-02 R-02.25); normally null for test.
floor.title: Floor

set.description: Identifier of the evaluation set that produced this score.
set.title: Set

ScoreRecord.title: ScoreRecord
